ex.en: A simple joke can break the ice at a party.
ex.zh: 在聚会上，一个简单的笑话就能打破沉默、活跃气氛。

ex.en: The math test was a piece of cake.
ex.zh: 那场数学考试简直是小菜一碟。

ex.en: Finals are next week, so I have to hit the books.
ex.zh: 下周就期末考试了，我得开始啃书本了。

ex.en: We finished the project, so let's call it a day.
ex.zh: 项目做完了，咱们就到此收工吧。

words.word: cost an arm and a leg

ex.en: The new phone cost an arm and a leg.
ex.zh: 这部新手机花了一大笔钱。

ex.en: She stayed home because she felt under the weather.
ex.zh: 她感觉身体不舒服，所以待在家里。

words.meaning: 咬紧牙关；硬着头皮去做

ex.en: I bit the bullet and apologized first.
ex.zh: 我咬紧牙关，先道了歉。

words.word: the ball is in your court
words.meaning: 该你行动了；主动权在你

ex.en: I have done my part; the ball is in your court.
ex.zh: 我该做的都做了，接下来看你的了。

ex.en: He burned the midnight oil to finish the report.
ex.zh: 他熬夜把报告赶完了。

ex.en: We eat out only once in a blue moon.
ex.zh: 我们难得才下回馆子。

ex.en: Speak of the devil - here he comes now!
ex.zh: 说曹操曹操到——他这不来了！

words.word: let the cat out of the bag

ex.en: She let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
ex.zh: 她把惊喜派对的事说漏嘴了。

words.word: kill two birds with one stone

ex.en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone: exercise and commuting.
ex.zh: 骑车上班一举两得：既锻炼了身体又通了勤。

ex.en: You finished the essay at last - better late than never.
ex.zh: 你总算把文章写完了——迟做总比不做好。

ex.en: Keep rehearsing; practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 继续练，熟能生巧。

ex.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
ex.zh: 入乡随俗嘛。

words.meaning: 因祸得福；看似不幸实则是福

ex.en: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
ex.zh: 丢了那份工作反倒是因祸得福。

ex.en: Working from home gives the best of both worlds.
ex.zh: 在家工作可谓两全其美。

ex.en: The argument got out of hand quickly.
ex.zh: 那场争执很快就失控了。

words.meaning: 收支相抵；勉强维持生计

ex.en: They work two jobs to make ends meet.
ex.zh: 他们打两份工才勉强维持生计。

ex.en: Let's make sure we are on the same page before we start.
ex.zh: 开始前咱们先确认一下想法是否一致。

ex.en: We do not always see eye to eye on politics.
ex.zh: 我们在政治问题上并不总是看法一致。

ex.en: After the exam, just take it easy for a while.
ex.zh: 考完试就先放松一会儿吧。

words.meaning: 不劳无获；一分耕耘一分收获

ex.en: No pain, no gain - keep training hard.
ex.zh: 不劳无获——继续刻苦训练吧。

words.meaning: 事实胜于雄辩；行动比言语更有力

ex.en: Actions speak louder than words, so show me.
ex.zh: 事实胜于雄辩，拿出行动来给我看。

words.meaning: 你在想什么（询问对方心事）

ex.en: You are quiet - a penny for your thoughts?
ex.zh: 你这么安静——在想什么呢？

words.meaning: 偷工减料；走捷径（常含贬义）

ex.en: Do not cut corners when building the deck.
ex.zh: 搭露台的时候可别偷工减料。

ex.en: He lied and now must face the music.
ex.zh: 他撒了谎，现在必须承担后果。

words.meaning: 冰山一角；只是很小一部分

ex.en: The reported cases are just the tip of the iceberg.
ex.zh: 上报的案件只是冰山一角。

ex.en: His comment only added fuel to the fire.
ex.zh: 他那一番话简直是火上浇油。

ex.en: Our new assistant is really on the ball.
ex.zh: 咱们新来的助理真的很机敏能干。

ex.en: Keep your chin up - things will improve.
ex.zh: 振作点——情况会好起来的。

ex.en: He spilled the beans about the gift.
ex.zh: 他把礼物的事说漏嘴了。

ex.en: Friends stick together through thick and thin.
ex.zh: 朋友之间要同甘共苦、不离不弃。

words.word: the early bird catches the worm
words.meaning: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃；捷足先登

ex.en: Set your alarm; the early bird catches the worm.
ex.zh: 定好闹钟，早起的鸟儿有虫吃。

ex.en: The exam is tough, but hang in there.
ex.zh: 考试很难，但一定要挺住。

ex.en: If you think I did it, you are barking up the wrong tree.
ex.zh: 要是你以为是我干的，那可就找错人了。

ex.en: Insurance gives me peace of mind.
ex.zh: 保险让我心里踏实、有份安心。

words.meaning: 跳出框框；打破常规思考

ex.en: To solve this, we must think outside the box.
ex.zh: 要解决这个问题，咱们得打破常规去思考。

words.meaning: 你说得对极了；完全同意

ex.en: This weather is awful. - You can say that again!
ex.zh: 这天气真糟。——你说得太对了！

words.meaning: 这不是什么难事；很简单

ex.en: Relax, it is not rocket science.
ex.zh: 放轻松，这又不是什么难事。

words.word: every cloud has a silver lining

ex.en: Every cloud has a silver lining; you will find a new job.
ex.zh: 黑暗中总有一线光明，你会找到新工作的。
